name: modcurses
description: A compact C++20 TUI library over ncursesw and PDCurses
$comment: builtin-baseline pins the port versions this project resolves against.
It is not optional: a git-clone vcpkg instance (the one bundled with
Visual Studio, for example) refuses to touch ports without it, so the
build would work against one vcpkg on the machine and fail against
another depending only on which one VCPKG_ROOT happened to name.
Bumping this line is how you take newer ports, deliberately.
